data.content:
Reporting for this sectionCBS SportsBBC

## Next match and fallout

Southampton were set to face local rivals Portsmouth this weekend after Eckert kept his job, and CBS Sports said the next game was against Portsmouth (7 a.m. ET, Paramount+ and CBS Sports Golazo Network). [...] Image: BBC

Reporting for this sectionBBC

## What the FA found

The FA found Eckert guilty of three breaches of FA Rule E3.1 in relation to misconduct from Dec. 2025 to May, and the Football Association said the incidents involved spying on Oxford United, Ipswich Town, and Middlesbrough.

Eckert was found to have ordered a member of Southampton staff to spy on Oxford United training before a game last December, and he also received CCTV footage of an Ipswich Town session in April. [...] Image from CBS Sports

Image: CBS Sports

The FA’s case centered most heavily on a Middlesbrough training observation in May to see whether midfielder Hayden Hackney was participating while dealing with an injury, and CBS Sports said the incident led Boro to report Southampton to the EFL.
